description: This file manages the local storage of game history for a Tic-Tac-Toe web platform, including functions to normalize, add, retrieve, clear, import, and export game history entries.

methods.name: normalizeEntry
methods.description: Validates and normalizes a single game history entry.

methods.name: entryId
methods.description: Creates a stable identifier for a history entry for de-duplication.

methods.name: normalizeList
methods.description: Normalizes an array of entries, sorts them newest first, and caps to MAX_ENTRIES.

methods.name: saveList
methods.description: Persists a list of normalized entries to local storage.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the game history list from local storage.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a new game history entry after normalization.

methods.name: clearHistory
methods.description: Clears the game history from local storage.

methods.name: parseImportPayload
methods.description: Validates and parses import payloads for history data.

methods.name: exportHistoryPayload
methods.description: Exports the current history as a portable payload with version info.

methods.name: replaceHistoryFromImport
methods.description: Replaces current history with imported entries.

methods.name: mergeHistoryFromImport
methods.description: Merges imported entries into current history, de-duplicating and capping size.
